ticket.title: Total Hours is displayed inconsistently in Month View

scope: Fix: in Attendance Month View the Total/Scheduled-hours toolbar stat aggregates over the whole displayed month, not the active ISO week, so the value is stable regardless of week anchor. Covers read-only verification on dev as admin account; no writes.

cases.title: Month View Total Hours is stable when revisiting the same month

steps.action: Open Attendance, switch to Month View, note Total Hours for the displayed month
steps.expected: Total Hours shown for the month
steps.actual: Month view October 2026: Scheduled hours 176, Total hours 0, Absence hours 48

steps.action: Go to another month then back to the same month; re-read Total Hours
steps.expected: Same Total Hours value as step 1
steps.actual: Round trip Jun->Jul->Aug->Jul->Jun: June 2026 stayed Scheduled 160 / Total 0 / Absence 160; July 184 both visits

cases.title: Month Total Hours equals sum of daily hours across the month (not a single week)

steps.action: In Month View compare Total Hours with sum of per-day hours/entries visible in the grid
steps.expected: Total equals sum over the whole month
steps.actual: Account has no attendance records (Total hours 0 in every month Jun-Oct 2026), so the sum of daily hours cannot be compared; needs an account with attendance data (ticket's 55h for June 2026)

cases.title: Total Hours unchanged when switching Week -> Month and between weeks anchors

steps.action: Switch to Week View, move to different weeks, then return to Month View for the same month
steps.expected: Month View Total Hours equals the value in TC01
steps.actual: Week view Scheduled 40 for 5-11, 12-18, 19-25 Oct; returning to Month view gives Scheduled 176 / Total 0, same as TC01 (month-wide, independent of week anchor)

observations: Total hours is 0 for Jun-Oct 2026 on this account: no attendance records, so the Total-hours aggregation could not be exercised.
